title: Enhanced Rate Limiting with IP Blocking
description: This feature matters as it prevents brute-force attacks and Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks by blocking IPs that exceed the rate limit. It does this by integrating a cache-based IP blocker that stores IP addresses and their request counts. This enhancement improves the security of the yantraverse framework
testCases: Test rate limiting with valid requests
Test rate limiting with excessive requests from a single IP
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the rate limiter correctly blocks IPs that exceed the limit and allows valid requests to pass through
reason: This feature is technically justified as it strengthens the security of the framework and is a high-impact addition that aligns with the focus on feature development and security
